user.title: Choose country
user.description: Choose a country, then narrow the location by region and county where available. Enter any city or town manually; online city lists are incomplete.

region.title: Choose region
region.description: Choose a broad region. The next step narrows to a county or sub-region.

city.title: Choose city
city.description: Choose a city or town from the available list. If your place is missing, choose the manual-entry option.

area.title: Choose local area
area.description: Choose an optional local area and enter any optional API credentials. EmlaLock, Chastify, and Chaster credentials are used only for read-only active-session checks to award daily calendar crowns.

data.chaster_access_token: Chaster developer or OAuth access token

county.title: Choose county or sub-region
county.description: Choose a county from the list where available. If county data is missing for your region, choose manual entry or skip this level.

city_manual.title: Enter city or town
city_manual.description: Enter a city or town not present in the dropdown.

county_manual.title: Enter county or sub-region
county_manual.description: Enter a county or local sub-region not present in the dropdown.
